external_sources.title: Spectral equivalence of matrix polynomials and the index sum theorem
external_sources.locator: Lemma 6.3 and Theorem 6.5, printed pages37-38 (PDF pages38-39 including cover)
external_sources.imported_statement: For an arbitrary matrix pencil over a field, the total finite/infinite structural indices and left/right minimal indices sum to its rational-function rank. The present use drops nonnegative structural indices.
external_sources.read: Full statements and their proofs inspected in this session.

external_sources.title: Another proof of Grothendieck's theorem on the splitting of vector bundles on the projective line
external_sources.imported_statement: An algebraic vector bundle on the projective line over a field splits as a direct sum of line bundles. Here it is applied to a basepoint-free polynomial evaluation kernel.
external_sources.read: Statement and surrounding algebraic hypotheses inspected in this session.

prior_credit: The scalar Hankel annihilator statement is classical and has an elementary proof in the prior local note. Their files and historical reports are unchanged.
